source_note: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散
english_source_note: Competing Decreasing Sequences and Series Divergence
callout_id: 两个非负不增序列互相竞争从而使得级数发散#8
statement_en:
Let $a_n$ be a nonnegative nonincreasing real sequence such that the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$ diverges. If $S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ has positive natural density, that is,
$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0,$$
then the subseries $\sum_{n\in S}a_n$ also diverges.
callout_body: 设$a_n$是一个非负，单调不增的实数列，且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}a_n$发散。如果$S\subseteq \mathbb{N}$是自然的一个子集，其自然密度为正，即$$d(S)=\lim_{N\to \infty} \frac{|S\cap \{1,2,\cdots,N\}|}{N}=\delta>0$$那么子级数$\sum_{n\in S}a_n$也发散。
